content: {"question":"When a team member in the Netherlands experiences a natural disaster and files a formal harassment complaint, which roles are responsible for handling the complaint and what initial communication must be sent?","answer":"The People Risk and Safety team must send a notification email, and the Chief People Officer or People Business Partner must immediately handle the written complaint.","evidence_a":"People Risk and Safety will send a notification email to all relevant team members and their manager, using the [template](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/people-group/General/-/blob/master/.gitlab/email_templates/natural_disaster_notification.md) found in the People Group project as a guideline","evidence_b":"Write a formal complaint and send it to the Chief People Officer or the People Business Partner. When the Chief People Officer or the People Business Partner receives the complaint, they must immediately handle the written complaint."}
